scenes.title: Rainy Night Encounter
scenes.narration: Under warm dim lantern light, Lia stands on the left side of the glass conservatory holding a closed crimson umbrella at her side while black cat Nyx sits on the right gazing at the blue-rose crystal vase on the center table.

scenes.title: Lia Falls Asleep
scenes.narration: Grown sleepy under the warm conservatory lanterns, Lia sets her closed red umbrella down beside her, sits down on the herringbone wooden floor right next to the left side of the round wooden table, rests her head comfortably against the tabletop edge on her folded arms, and falls fast asleep with her eyes closed, while black cat Nyx sits quietly on the right watching sleeping Lia; the glowing blue-rose crystal vase remains intact at the center of the table.

scenes.title: Nyx Jumps Onto Lia's Head
scenes.narration: While Lia stays peacefully fast asleep with her head resting on her folded arms at the left of the table, black cat Nyx crouches on the right, springs lightly through the air across the conservatory, and lands perched playfully right on top of sleeping Lia's silver-haired head, settling its paws and curling its tail there while the glowing blue-rose crystal vase remains intact on the center table.

scenes.title: Lia Wakes & Breaks the Vase
scenes.narration: Startled awake by black cat Nyx perched on her head, Lia gasps and jolts upright suddenly as Nyx hops off safely to the floor on the right; Lia's startled elbow sweeps across the round wooden center table, knocking the glowing blue-rose crystal vase off the table edge so it crashes down and shatters into sparkling glass shards, spilled water, and scattered blue petals on the wooden floor.
